howto.name: Upload an SVG
howto.text: Drop a .svg file up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Choose scale factor
howto.text: 1x = SVG native size. 2x, 3x, 4x for higher-resolution exports.

howto.name: Download the PNG
howto.text: PrivaTools rasterizes the vector via cairosvg at the chosen scale with anti-aliasing.

faq.a: PNG is universally supported (email, legacy apps, social media uploads). SVG can break in tools that don't render it (Gmail, some Slack clients).

faq.q: How large should the output be?
faq.a: For social media: 1200×630 (use Resize Crop Image after). For app icons: 1024×1024 base. For web retina: 2x your design size.
Yes — SVG transparency translates to PNG alpha. The PNG is fully alpha-channel.
